summary: The 6-K reports the departure of two directors (Baoqing Sun, Class B and committee member; Zhizhong Hu, Class C, who remains CTO) and the immediate appointment of Di Gan as Class B director and committee member, and Johnny Tiong Sie Wei as Class C director. Resignations were for personal reasons with no disagreement. Appointees bring operational and management experience. This is a routine board composition change, not a forced departure, so it borders on 'None' but is classified as Management Changes given the event-driven nature of the filing. No deal terms, advisor, or premium applies.
